notes.text: Section 1011, act July 9, 1952, ch. 608, pt. II, § 260, as added Aug. 9, 1955, ch. 665, § 2(h), 69 Stat. 599, related to records of persons participating in active and inactive duty training. See section 10204 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
Section 1012, act July 9, 1952, ch. 608, pt. II, § 261, as added Aug. 9, 1955, ch. 665, § 2(i), 69 Stat. 600, related to period of enlistment in Reserve components. See section 12103 of Title 10.
